note.title: Bienvenue à Paris — travel and tourist information
note.overview: Use practical French to understand and describe Paris, travel and tourist information.
learningGoals: Use travel language accurately in short sentences.
mustMemoriseRules: Use à Paris for a city and en France for a feminine country.
Read times, opening information and transport instructions carefully.

workedExamples.prompt: Translate: Le musée ouvre à neuf heures.
workedExamples.answer: The museum opens at nine o’clock.
workedExamples.why: Le musée names the place; ouvre means opens; à neuf heures gives the opening time.

workedExamples.prompt: Say where you are travelling: Paris, France.
workedExamples.answer: Je voyage à Paris, en France.
workedExamples.why: Use à before a city and en before a feminine country.
J’ai pris is the perfect tense of prendre: avoir + the past participle pris.

commonMistakes: Confusing à Paris with en Paris.
Missing the opening time, closure day or transport instruction.
detailedExplanation: This topic is enabled because it is explicitly within the official Tiffin Girls’ School Year 9 French Curriculum Outline 2026-27.

The school outline verifies the curriculum scope and grammar focus but does not publish the teacher’s exact weekly vocabulary list. Context vocabulary here is standard French used to practise the verified scope, not an exact teacher-issued word list.
French accents are corrected and displayed, but a missing accent alone does not lose the mark in this app.
examTips: Underline the time clue before choosing a tense.
Check subject + verb, agreement, article choice and negative word order.
Answer the exact task before adding detail.

quickCheck.question: Give the English meaning of une gare.
quickCheck.explanation: Une gare is a railway station; learn une with the noun.

quickCheck.question: Complete: Je voyage ___ Paris.
quickCheck.explanation: Use à before a city name.

quickCheck.question: Le musée ouvre à neuf heures. At what time does it open? Answer in English.

beforeStartingPractice: Read the note once, then answer from memory.

additionalSourceSections.heading: Place → travel → visit
additionalSourceSections.body:
une gare → a station: where you catch a train
le métro → the metro: transport within the city
un billet → a ticket: what you buy for the journey
un musée / un monument → a museum / a monument: a place to visit
À Paris = in/to Paris; en France = in/to France.
